scientific_question: Which high-speed airflow region is strongest in the office, and where is it located? Identify contiguous high-speed regions using an appropriate speed-based criterion and use an appropriate measure to compare their strength. Treat locations connected through shared grid faces as belonging to the same region, represent the selected region by the mean spatial location of its high-speed locations, and report its location and strength.
